rows.grounds: accusative object denoting the letter dha
appositional identification with the syllable dha
compound: mokṣa+rūpiṇī; describes kuṇḍalī as having the form of liberation

items.question: What liberative identity does the syllable dha embody as kuṇḍalī?
premises: The syllable dha is addressed as the object of contemplation.
The syllable dha is identified as kuṇḍalī.
This kuṇḍalī is characterized as having the form of liberation.
items.inference: Therefore, the syllable dha, as kuṇḍalī, embodies the very form of liberation.
uncertainties: The exact compound analysis of mokṣarūpiṇī as bahuvrīhī or karmadhāraya is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: O supreme goddess, the syllable dha is kuṇḍalī, whose very form is liberation.
